audit.title: Automation Interfaces
audit.summary: This is a Chainlink Automation interface reference covering `AutomationCompatibleInterface` (`checkUpkeep`/`performUpkeep`) with clear parameter breakdowns and primary-source GitHub links. Its biggest strength is a clean, well-chunked structure with authoritative inline citations; its biggest liability is that two of the three interface sections named in the intro — **`## ILogAutomation`** and **`## StreamsLookupCompatibleInterface`** — render as empty headings in the served content, so a retrieval engine that lands there finds nothing to lift. Combined with completely absent structured metadata (no JSON-LD, canonical, or dates), the page under-delivers on machine-readability despite strong prose. Fix the empty sections and add schema, and this comfortably reaches Strong.

recommendations.title: Fill the empty `ILogAutomation` and `StreamsLookupCompatibleInterface` sections
recommendations.issue: both headings have zero body content in the served page
recommendations.change: add, for each, a one-sentence canonical definition + the interface function signature + a GitHub source link, mirroring the `AutomationCompatibleInterface` treatment (e.g., "`ILogAutomation` lets a log event emitted onchain trigger your upkeep via `checkLog(Log calldata log, bytes memory checkData)`…").
recommendations.why: empty sections are unretrievable; an engine landing on these anchors returns nothing, and the intro's promises go unfulfilled. Highest-impact fix on the page.

recommendations.title: Add TechArticle JSON-LD, canonical URL, and last-updated date
recommendations.change: emit a `TechArticle` JSON-LD block with `headline`, `dateModified`, `programmingLanguage: Solidity`, and a `<link rel="canonical">`; surface a visible "Last updated" line.
recommendations.why: structured metadata and freshness signals raise agent trust (E-E-A-T) and parse reliability. Note: `<head>` was not captured, so absence should be confirmed by passing raw head to the CLI.

recommendations.title: Make code blocks agent-runnable
recommendations.issue: "of 2 block(s) … 2 show none" (no imports); inconsistent `sol` vs `solidity` tags
recommendations.change: add `pragma solidity ^0.8.0;` and the `import {AutomationCompatibleInterface} from "…";` line to at least one canonical example; standardize the fence tag to `solidity`.
recommendations.why: copy-pasteable, imported snippets are lifted and executed by coding agents; consistent language tags aid parsing.

recommendations.title: Add symptom-phrased entry points
recommendations.issue: advice is present but concept-titled ("Ensure that your `performUpkeep` is *idempotent*")
recommendations.change: add an H3 or FAQ line phrased as the query, e.g. "**Why does my upkeep keep performing the same work repeatedly?**" answered by the idempotency guidance.
recommendations.why: devs/agents query by symptom; question-phrased headings win retrieval that concept prose loses.

recommendations.title: Replace vague quantifiers with numbers
recommendations.issue: "several hundred account balances", "a number of addresses"
recommendations.change: where a real bound exists, state it (e.g., gas-limit ceiling, max array size per upkeep); otherwise keep the concrete "0 to 49" style example already present.
recommendations.why: quantitative specifics are among the highest-lift changes for citation.

antiPatterns: **Empty content sections** — `## ILogAutomation` and `## StreamsLookupCompatibleInterface` are headings with no body; the intro links to them as if populated.
**Vague quantifiers** — "several", "a number of" where a figure would serve.
**Snippets missing imports/pragma** — all Solidity blocks lack imports; one inconsistent `sol` tag.
No keyword stuffing, marketing fluff, or stale-cross-reference issues detected.
offPageNotes: `llms.txt` is already referenced at the top — good; ensure it indexes this page.
Site-level: JSON-LD/canonical/date emission is likely template-controlled; fix once at the docs-platform level to benefit all reference pages.
The empty sections may be populated by a client-side component not present in served HTML — if so, ensure the interface content is server-rendered so retrieval crawlers see it.
